summary: Construct a Node-compatible EventEmitter helper object rather than mapping to a C# event/delegate.

target.notes: Creates an emitter that preserves duplicate listeners, string/Symbol event names, synchronous dispatch, meta-events, and Node error-event behavior.

caveats: C# events do not expose EventEmitter return values, duplicate-removal rules, Symbol keys, or unhandled 'error' behavior.
captureRejections changes rejection routing and requires the helper option to be preserved when present.

tests.name: independent emitter
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const a=new EventEmitter(); const b=new EventEmitter(); let n=0; a.on('x',()=>n++); b.emit('x'); console.log(n);

tests.name: symbol event name
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); const s=Symbol(); let n=0; e.on(s,()=>n++); e.emit(s); console.log(n);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 1; Symbol event names remain distinct
